lessons.name: Who is the biggest animal in the world? (2-5)

passageLines.text: There is an octopus in the sea.
He thinks he is the biggest animal in the world.
passageLines.ko: 그는 자신이 세상에서 가장 큰 동물이라고 생각해요.

passageLines.text: "Hey, who is the biggest animal in the world?

lessons.name: Who is the biggest animal in the world? (6-9)

passageLines.text: Next, the octopus sees a squid.
The squid is jumping up and down.
"Hey, who is the biggest animal in the world?
Next, the octopus sees a starfish.
"Hey, who is the biggest animal in the world?

lessons.name: Who is the biggest animal in the world? (10-13)

passageLines.text: Next, the octopus sees a seahorse.
The seahorse is swimming back and forth.
"Hey, who is the biggest animal in the world?
Next, the octopus sees a jellyfish.
"Hey, who is the biggest animal in the world?

lessons.name: Who is the biggest animal in the world? (14-23)

passageLines.text: Then, the octopus sees a blue whale.
passageLines.ko: 그리고 나서, 문어는 푸른 고래 한 마리를 봅니다.

passageLines.text: The blue whale is taking a rest.
"Hey, who is the biggest animal in the world?
The blue whale opens his mouth.
He swallows the octopus in one gulp.
The octopus sees the crab, the squid, the starfish, the seahorse, and the jellyfish.
passageLines.ko: 문어는 게, 오징어, 불가사리, 해마, 그리고 해파리를 봅니다.

passageLines.text: "You are not the biggest animal in the world," says the crab, "but you are the biggest animal in the blue whale.
passageLines.ko: "너는 세상에서 가장 큰 동물이 아니야." 게가 말합니다. "하지만 너는 푸른 고래 안에서는 가장 큰 동물이지."

passageLines.text: All the other animals start laughing at the octopus.
passageLines.ko: 다른 모든 동물들이 문어를 비웃기 시작합니다.

passageLines.text: They make fun of the octopus.
The octopus is not proud anymore.
Frog saves one cup of cocoa in his fridge.
passageLines.ko: 개구리는 냉장고에 코코아 한 잔을 보관해요.

passageLines.text: He saves it for the next day.
passageLines.ko: 그는 다음 날을 위해 그것을 아껴 두었어요.

passageLines.text: When he wakes up, it's gone.
passageLines.ko: 그가 잠에서 깨어났을 때, 코코아가 사라졌어요.

passageLines.text: Frog looks for clues around the fridge.
Cow saves two cartons of milk in her fridge.
passageLines.ko: 암소는 냉장고에 우유 두 팩을 보관해요.

passageLines.text: She saves them for the next day.
passageLines.ko: 그녀는 다음 날을 위해 그것들을 아껴 두었어요.

passageLines.text: When she wakes up, they're gone.
passageLines.ko: 그녀가 잠에서 깨어났을 때, 우유가 사라졌어요.

passageLines.text: Cow looks for clues around the fridge.
Mouse saves three pieces of cheese in his fridge.
passageLines.ko: 쥐가 냉장고에 치즈 세 조각을 보관해요.

passageLines.text: He saves them for the next day.
When he wakes up, they're gone.
passageLines.ko: 그가 잠에서 깨어나 보니, 치즈가 사라졌어요.

passageLines.text: Mouse looks for clues around the fridge.
Lion saves four cans of beans in her fridge.
passageLines.ko: 사자는 냉장고에 콩 통조림 네 개를 보관해요.

passageLines.text: She saves them for the next day.
When she wakes up, they're gone.
passageLines.ko: 그녀가 잠에서 깨어나 보니, 콩 통조림이 사라졌어요.
누군가 콩 통조림을 훔쳐 간 거예요.

passageLines.text: Lion looks for clues around the fridge.
Sparrow saves five bowls of rice in his fridge.
passageLines.ko: 스패로우는 냉장고에 밥 다섯 그릇을 보관합니다.

passageLines.text: He saves them for the next day.
passageLines.ko: 그는 다음 날을 위해 그것들을 보관합니다.

passageLines.text: When he wakes up, they're gone.
passageLines.ko: 그가 잠에서 깨어나자, 그것들은 사라지고 없었습니다.

passageLines.text: Sparrow looks for clues around the fridge.
Frog, Cow, Mouse, Lion, and Sparrow gather together.
passageLines.ko: 프로그, 카우, 마우스, 라이언, 그리고 스패로우가 함께 모입니다.

passageLines.text: They don't know who the thief is.
They put their heads together to catch the thief.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 도둑을 잡기 위해 머리를 맞댑니다.

passageLines.text: Frog, Cow, Mouse, Lion, and Sparrow put a fridge in the forest.
passageLines.ko: 개구리, 소, 쥐, 사자, 그리고 참새가 숲에 냉장고를 놓았습니다.

passageLines.text: They put one cup of cocoa, two cartons of milk, three pieces of cheese, four cans of beans, and five bowls of rice in the fridge.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 냉장고 안에 코코아 한 잔, 우유 두 팩, 치즈 세 조각, 콩 통조림 네 개, 그리고 밥 다섯 그릇을 넣었습니다.

passageLines.text: They hide and watch the fridge.
They watch the fridge day and night.
Finally, at night, a big, dark creature comes along.
passageLines.ko: 마침내 밤이 되자, 크고 어두운 생명체가 나타납니다.

passageLines.text: The big, dark creature opens the fridge.
He starts to take the food out of the fridge.
The big, dark creature is surprised.
He hides himself in the fridge.
He locks himself up in the fridge.

passageLines.text: It is a cold winter day.
She makes a nose with a carrot.
She makes a mouth with a banana.
Hope thinks the snowman is cold.
She puts a hat on his head.
She puts a muffler around his neck.
She puts gloves on his hands.
It is late in the evening.
The moon is up in the sky.
Hope and the snowman are in the sky.
The stars are here, there, everywhere.
The clouds are here, there, everywhere.
The sun is about to come out.
He puts her in her bed.
It is early in the morning.
The sun is up in the sky.
She looks out of the window.
She only sees a puddle of water.
Then, she hears someone call her.
passageLines.ko: 그때, 그녀는 누군가 자신을 부르는 소리를 듣는다.

passageLines.text: "It's me, the snowman," says the water.
I'll come back when it snows.
Ben and Mike are very different.
Ben and Mike are best friends.
They have fun together every day.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 매일 함께 즐거운 시간을 보내요.

passageLines.text: Ben and Mike go to the park together.
They play in the grass together.
Ben and Mike go to the beach together.
Ben and Mike go to the field together.
Ben and Mike stay at home together.
"Let's make a Christmas tree together," Mike says.
"Let's ride in the sleigh together," Mike says.
passageLines.ko: "우리 같이 썰매 타러 가자," 마이크가 말한다.

passageLines.text: "If you sleep, you will miss making a Christmas tree," Mike says.
passageLines.ko: "네가 자면 크리스마스트리 만드는 걸 놓칠 거야," 마이크가 말한다.

passageLines.text: "If you sleep, you will also miss riding in the sleigh," Mike says.
passageLines.ko: "네가 자면 썰매 타는 것도 놓칠 거야," 마이크가 말한다.

passageLines.text: "No, I won't, but I will miss you, Mike," Ben says.
passageLines.ko: "아니, 안 놓칠 거야, 하지만 마이크, 네가 그리울 거야," 벤이 말한다.

passageLines.text: Ben and Mike smile at each other.
"I will wake you up when spring comes," Mike says.
passageLines.ko: "봄이 오면 내가 너를 깨워줄게," 마이크가 말한다.

passageLines.text: Ben and Mike give each other a big hug.
